# `Target`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Per-target state of a running ViewPlan (and of the legacy autosave plan).

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only; receiving the event changes nothing) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, print_target_state @0x402c80, ViewPlanTargetFunc @0x408880, AutoSavePlan @0x30ea00, plan-progress helper NotifyPlan @0xb2040 (callers @0x30f15c, near @0x30fb10) (64-bit build); 32-bit counterpart differs as described |

Two producers share this name. (1) The ViewPlan target worker sends F-family function events (idle, working, complete, fail, cancel) through the Target function detail; the target callback adds target_id and camera_mode only when a current target exists, wide_state (and wide_code/wide_error on fail) for wide and dual targets, and output objects with stacked-second counters when the main or wide output is non-empty. The callback does not add the plan-list scheduling fields (start_min, duration_min and so on); those appear only inside the ViewPlan event's plan.list. (2) The legacy autosave plan sends start and complete through the plan-progress helper, with state and progress only (no target members). Select the contract by producer, not by name. Broadcast on TCP 4700 to every retained socket; delivery is not guaranteed and order relative to ViewPlan events and RPC replies is not established. The 32-bit build's callback writes target_id, camera_mode, output_file and stack_total_sec but not the wide_* members. APK consumer: the app's target handler; the app deliberately does not require a route on this event.

Side effects: None for the receiver; the device sends this without a request.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"Target"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | F state table for ViewPlan targets (idle, working, complete, fail, cancel); the legacy autosave path sends the literals start and complete through the plan-progress helper. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`, `start`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | if a non-empty stage string is held | - | Only when a non-empty stage string is held. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if state is working, or the timer was started (terminal states) | - | Elapsed milliseconds, independent of Timestamp. Working (or started with no end) uses current monotonic minus start; other terminal states use end minus start. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | no | - | Ordered function-tree ancestry when included; a missing route is a legitimate branch. Not an address. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if F producer and state is fail | - | F: written for state fail even with a stored zero code. Not written by the legacy producer. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if F producer and state is fail | - | F: written for state fail, including stored zero. Not written by the legacy producer. [READ] |
| `target_id` | integer | if F producer with a current target | - | F producer, only when a current target iterator exists. [READ] |
| `camera_mode` | string | if F producer with a current target | - | tele, wide or dual. [READ] |
| `wide_state` | string | if wide or dual target (64-bit build) | - | Wide and dual targets. [READ] |
| `wide_code` | integer | if wide_state is fail | - | Wide-camera code. [READ] |
| `wide_error` | string | if wide_state is fail | - | Wide-camera error message. [READ] |
| `output_file` | object | if tele or dual target with non-empty main output | - | Tele and dual targets, when the main output buffer is non-empty. `{path, files}` with exactly one file entry. [READ] |
| `output_file.path` | string | yes | - | Output directory, relative to the storage root, without a trailing slash. [READ] |
| `output_file.files` | array<object> | yes | - | One object for the saved file; the builder pushes a single entry (no loop). Range: at least 1 item(s). [READ] |
| `output_file.files[].name` | string | yes | - | File path relative to the storage root. [READ] |
| `output_file.files[].date` | string | yes | - | Image date from the image metadata. [READ] |
| `output_file.files[].thn` | string | yes | - | Thumbnail name. [READ] |
| `output_file.files[].type` | integer | yes | - | Album file-type code [READ] |
| `stack_total_sec` | number | if output_file is present | - | Stacked seconds from a stored float counter; same branch as output_file. [READ] |
| `wide_output_file` | object | if wide or dual target with non-empty wide output (64-bit build) | - | Wide and dual targets, when the wide output buffer is non-empty. `{path, files}` with exactly one file entry. [READ] |
| `wide_output_file.path` | string | yes | - | Output directory, relative to the storage root, without a trailing slash. [READ] |
| `wide_output_file.files` | array<object> | yes | - | One object for the saved file; the builder pushes a single entry (no loop). Range: at least 1 item(s). [READ] |
| `wide_output_file.files[].name` | string | yes | - | File path relative to the storage root. [READ] |
| `wide_output_file.files[].date` | string | yes | - | Image date from the image metadata. [READ] |
| `wide_output_file.files[].thn` | string | yes | - | Thumbnail name. [READ] |
| `wide_output_file.files[].type` | integer | yes | - | Album file-type code [READ] |
| `progress` | object | if legacy autosave plan producer | - | Legacy plan progress; same formatter output as get_app_state progress. [READ] |
| `progress.targets` | object | no | - | [READ] |
| `progress.targets.total` | integer | no | - | Planned target total. [READ] |
| `progress.targets.lapse` | integer | no | - | Completed planned target count (a count, not milliseconds); 'completed' is inferred from the counter names. [READ; completed-count meaning INFERRED] |
| `progress.cur_plan` | object | no | - | [READ] |
| `progress.cur_plan.total` | integer | no | - | Current-plan total. [READ] |
| `progress.cur_plan.lapse` | integer | no | - | Completed current-plan count (a count, not milliseconds); 'completed' is inferred from the counter names. [READ; completed-count meaning INFERRED] |
| `progress.cur_target` | object | no | - | [READ] |
| `progress.cur_target.total` | integer | no | - | Target total. [READ] |
| `progress.cur_target.lapse` | integer | no | - | Completed target count (a count, not milliseconds); 'completed' is inferred from the counter names. [READ; completed-count meaning INFERRED] |
| `progress.cur_target.target_name` | string | no | - | Current target name; empty when there is no current target. [READ] |
| `progress.cur_target.id` | integer | no | - | Target id; -2147483648 when there is no current target. [READ] |
| `progress.cur_seq` | object | no | - | [READ] |
| `progress.cur_seq.total` | integer | no | - | Sequence frame total. [READ] |
| `progress.cur_seq.lapse` | integer | no | - | Completed sequence frame count (a count, not milliseconds); 'completed' is inferred from the counter names. [READ; completed-count meaning INFERRED] |
| `progress.cur_seq.frame_type` | string | no | - | Frame type name. light, dark, bias or flat for codes 0 to 3; unknown otherwise, including when there is no current sequence. One of: `light`, `dark`, `bias`, `flat`, `unknown`. [READ] |
| `progress.cur_seq.id` | integer | no | - | Sequence id; -2147483648 when there is no current sequence. [READ] |
| `progress.plan_end` | boolean | no | - | End flag; false when no plan run is current. [READ] |
| `wide_stack_total_sec` | number | if wide_output_file is present | - | Wide stacked seconds; same branch as wide_output_file. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, working - ViewPlan target running (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"Target","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"working","lapse_ms":61000,"route":["ViewPlan"],"target_id":1790000000,"camera_mode":"tele"}
```

Event, complete-with-output - ViewPlan target finished with saved output (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"Target","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"complete","lapse_ms":5400000,"route":["ViewPlan"],"target_id":1790000000,"camera_mode":"tele","output_file":{"path":"Example_target","files":[{"name":"Stacked_example.fit","date":"2026-01-01 00:00:00","thn":"Stacked_example_thn.jpg","type":0}]},"stack_total_sec":3600.0}
```

Event, legacy-start - Legacy autosave target start (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"Target","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"start","progress":{"targets":{"total":2,"lapse":0},"cur_plan":{"total":2,"lapse":0},"cur_target":{"total":30,"lapse":12,"target_name":"Example target","id":1},"cur_seq":{"total":30,"lapse":12,"frame_type":"light","id":1},"plan_end":false}}
```
